Dallas Detox Center Offers Addiction Treatment near Highland Park, TX

blocks.html:
If you or a loved one has been struggling with drugs and alcohol, you may benefit from a drug and alcohol detox center in Highland Park. Dallas Detox Center provides detox and residential inpatient treatment services. Our detoxification program includes 24/7 medical supervision. We recognize the discomfort and health concerns that can arise during detoxification, which is why our staff will work with you to ease your discomfort. Once you have completed your detox, you will then be able to participate in our residential inpatient program.

The residential inpatient treatment program at Dallas Detox Center uses a combination of group therapy, individual therapy, and educational sessions to help you establish a solid foundation for your recovery. We believe that you are the expert of your life, and will provide you with the support and encouragement you need to navigate early recovery.

Our luxurious treatment facility can provide you with mental health treatment if this would benefit you. Common mental health concerns among individuals who are living with addiction include anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, borderline personality disorder, and trauma-related concerns. Additionally, we offer specialized treatment groups for men, women, veterans, young adults, college students, and members of the LGBTQ+ community.

A unique component of the Dallas Detox Center is our alumni services program. We recognize that recovery can have unexpected twists and turns, which is why we offer check-in phone calls or visits with individuals who have completed our inpatient treatment program. Additionally, if you ever find yourself in a position where you are in active addiction, we can work with you to navigate the readmission process.
